(4) There is no consequence.rowexpunge sentence in docs/development/ux-substrate/screens/words.json. Owner: Bob's design stream. There the interpretation writes (interpretmark, acceptProposals, interpretationWithdraw) await BOB's grade, and the layer ops are only the worker's proposal by analogy, for BOB to confirm. Neither the interpretation ops nor layersset or federaloffices are declared by any owner. mail-door declares mailbringin weight reasoned (src/mail-door/index.mjs:690), where surface-declarations R17 grades it as captureupload. Owners: a ruling by BOB; then surface-declarations' lanes (mail-door, interpretation, layers); and R58's citation is to be re-pointed to surface-declarations R17. Restart this job once these land. op-grades then needs only its tests and, for R55 and R57, the hand rows.
